solutions.title: Hash map old nodes to clones
solutions.strategy: Create one clone for every original node, store old-to-new mappings, then wire next and random pointers from the map.

timeComplexity.explanation: Two linear passes visit each original node once to allocate clones and once to connect pointers.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The map stores one clone reference for every original node.

solutions.title: Weave clones into the original list
solutions.strategy: Insert each clone directly after its original node, set clone random pointers through adjacent clone nodes, then detach the cloned list.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each pass walks the list once: weave, assign random pointers, and detach.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Aside from the cloned nodes that are required for the output, only a few pointer variables are used.
